name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: AI Marketing Operations | HubSpot Automation, GEO, Paid Media & Email Infrastructure
summary: Marketing operations builder working where CRM automation, paid media, and generative AI meet. I build lead scoring, lifecycle stages, and nurture automation in HubSpot and GoHighLevel, run LinkedIn and Google Ads, set up SPF/DKIM/DMARC and warm-up myself at 99%+ deliverability, and deploy tracking through Google Tag Manager. I've built a 9-dimension framework for how AI search and LLMs read and cite a business, and published 10 articles on semantic SEO and generative engine optimization.

Published 10 articles on semantic SEO, Google AI Overviews, and why ChatGPT won't recommend a business, part of 18 posts on the Solenzo blog.
Build lead scoring, qualification criteria, lifecycle stages, and email and SMS nurture in HubSpot and GoHighLevel, with marketing-to-CRM syncs and data hygiene standards.
Set up sending domains, SPF/DKIM/DMARC, and warm-up for outbound email, holding deliverability above 99%.
Build AI-driven workflows calling the OpenAI and Claude APIs inside n8n, Make, and Zapier to score prospects and generate personalized outreach.
Deploy GA4 events, Meta Pixel, and Google Ads conversion tags through custom GTM triggers and variables, and work directly in HTML/CSS.
